title: Record and qualify a new lead
summary: A new lead entered with a short note on how likely it is to buy.

asks.label: What is their budget, if known?

text: Record a new lead: [name] from [company], reached through [source], interested in [what-they-want]. Note their budget if known [budget] and write two lines on how likely they are to buy and why. Keep it as a draft record for me to check.
